details: Version 2.21.0 loads an obfuscated lib/config.js when the package is imported. The embedded payload decrypts saved Chromium browser passwords, collects browser wallet-extension data, and uploads the collected files to hard-coded endpoints at 167.88.172.33 on ports 8085 and 8086. A Socket.IO payload connects to port 8087 and accepts commands to open and control interactive shells. These undisclosed credential-theft and remote-control capabilities are unrelated to the advertised logging functionality.

files.note: Obfuscated code loaded by index.js; embeds credential theft and remote shell payloads.
